goal: Bootstrap dau-viet-backend (Java 21 + Spring Boot + PostgreSQL + Flyway, modular monolith) and ship public read API for Historical Events with dev seed data.

acceptanceCriteria.text: dau-viet-backend contains a buildable Spring Boot application (Maven wrapper, pom.xml, main class) that compiles under Java 21.
docker compose provides PostgreSQL locally; Flyway migrations run successfully on a clean database; ddl-auto is not update.
historicalevent module follows modular monolith layout (api/application/domain/infrastructure); no business logic in controllers; constructor injection only.

GET /api/v1/events (paginated) and GET /api/v1/events/{id} return learner-safe data only; JPA entities never serialized; errors follow {code,message,details,traceId} envelope with correct HTTP status.
Schema uses UUID PKs, snake_case, timestamptz UTC, indexes/constraints; does not block future historical_events 1-N lessons relation.
Idempotent dev-only seed provides Bach Dang 938 event; never auto-loads in production profile.
Spring Security foundation present (public read permitted, deny-by-default otherwise), dev CORS policy without production wildcard, Actuator health enabled.
Unit/integration tests pass: context load, Flyway+PostgreSQL, repository, controller/service, validation/not-found, draft-not-exposed; unverifiable items reported NOT VERIFIED.
README documents local run; Flutter contract deltas vs lib/mock models recorded for next task.

nextAction: 22/22 tests green (real actuator health IT + insert-only seed verified) + backend-ci.yml added. Run `pwsh -File scripts/harness/harness.ps1 verify -TaskId TASK-0005` on a pwsh-7 host, then `finish`. Next task: Flutter events integration per docs/backend-flutter-contract-notes.md.
